description: This PHP source file defines the CustomLoader class within the Api\Core\Loader namespace. It provides static methods for managing custom file paths, loading and merging custom configuration arrays, handling errors, and loading custom routes for an API framework built on Slim. The class facilitates inclusion of user-defined configurations, route definitions, and error management to support extensibility in the SuiteCRM project.

classes.name: CustomLoader
classes.description: Provides static methods to load, merge, and manage custom configuration and route files for the SuiteCRM API framework.

methods.name: setCustomPath
methods.description: Sets the static property custom file path used for loading custom configurations.

methods.name: getCustomPath
methods.description: Returns the current custom file path used by the loader.

methods.name: getLastError
methods.description: Retrieves and resets the last error code encountered during loader operations.

methods.name: arrayMerge
methods.description: Recursively merges multiple arrays, concatenating numeric keys and merging associative keys.

methods.name: mergeCustomArray
methods.description: Includes a custom PHP file returning an array and merges it into an existing array, handling errors if the file isn't found or isn't properly formatted.

methods.name: loadCustomRoutes
methods.description: Includes a custom routes PHP file into the Slim application if it exists.
